page.overview:
Who is Appendix Guy?

The appendix guy is a man whose appendix randomly became inflamed and about to burst, causing him to fall down unconscious while he was walking in Springfield. Dr. Hibbert, who was luckily nearby, removed his appendix thanks to a knife he carries. He threw the appendix far away, and it somehow exploded. The appendix guy immediately recovered, emerging fully recovered seconds after the crude surgery.
